basic_info.description: First time on the market in over 50 years, this charming single-family home offers an incredible opportunity to live in a highly desirable location. Nestled just moments away from popular restaurants, wonderful shopping, Golden Gate Park, and the beach, this home perfectly blends convenience with serene surroundings.    Featuring two to three bedrooms and one bathroom, the property boasts a thoughtfully updated kitchen, a cozy fireplace, and a skylight that fills the home with natural light. Sitting on a great lot, the home offers ample potential for outdoor enjoyment or future enhancements.    The large garage provides plenty of room for parking and additional storage, making it both practical and versatile. Whether you're a first-time buyer or looking for a new place to call home, this property is brimming with possibilities. Don't miss this rare chance to make it yours! Trust Sale, NO Death on property.  Seller Motivated, Make offer!!
